GIN.note: Only draft implementing texts on electronic civil-status data exchange; no link planned between register and ID system is stated.
Draft texts mention paper and electronic registration media; no digital register in service or rollout stated.

facts.fact: PN-RAVEC held sessions to review draft implementing decrees and orders under laws L/2023/019/CNT on identification of natural persons and L/2023/020/CNT on civil status; the story does not say the laws are in force or that they provide for a digital identity.
